title: Spurious gauge-invariance and gamma5 in dimensional regularization
claim: Introduces auxiliary fields that restore a spurious gauge invariance of the BMHV-regularized theory; combined with the background field method, all 1PI amplitudes and counterterms become formally covariant and strongly constrained; computes one-loop symmetry-restoring counterterms for the most general renormalizable gauge theory with Dirac fermions and scalars (SM as special case).
theory: general renormalizable gauge theory with fermions and scalars
scheme: BMHV DREG + spurion-like auxiliary fields + background field method.
symmetry_argument: Spurious (formal) gauge covariance restored by auxiliary fields.

proved: One-loop restoring counterterms for the general theory.

notes: Conceptually the closest to a BV-type treatment: the auxiliary fields act like spurions whose BRST transformations make the regularized action formally invariant.
